title: The Echo That Reached the Throne
intro: A burdened figure approached the seat of justice, their voice trembling not with fear but with hope. The matter was personal, yet its resolution would echo through time, dismantling an oppressive tradition. Who was this soul whose complaint was heard beyond the stars?
clues: I came with a heavy heart, seeking justice in a matter that bound my tongue.
My plea was not just to a messenger; it ascended beyond, to the One who hears all.
The words spoken against me were like chains of an ancient past.
I argued and reasoned, with tears and with logic, for my dignity.
A revelation descended, silencing the old ways and acknowledging my pain.
They call me the one who disputed about my husband, and my name became synonymous with the chapter that freed me.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Wife of Imran (Mother of Maryam)
The Woman Who Disputed about Her Husband (Khawla bint Tha'laba)
The Queen of Sheba (Bilqis)
The Mother of Moses
The Wife of Pharaoh (Asiyah)
identity.answer: The Woman Who Disputed about Her Husband (Khawla bint Tha'laba)

trial.label: The Trial or Event
options: She was falsely accused of unchastity
She was barren and longed for a child
She faced an oppressive divorce custom
She was a queen negotiating with a prophet
She hid her child from a tyrant
trial.answer: She faced an oppressive divorce custom

location.label: Key Element
options: A golden calf
A magnificent throne
The practice of Zihar
A basket in the river
A sacred vow of dedication

outcome.label: Outcome
options: She was blessed with a child in old age
She was saved from drowning
She obtained a divine revelation abolishing the custom
She became a queen after a test
She was granted a son who became a prophet
outcome.answer: She obtained a divine revelation abolishing the custom

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
